title: Quick Seared Korean Chorizo Noodles
description: A garlicky, chewy, crowd-pleaser Korean dish featuring chorizo, infused oil, and served on a hot stone plate, perfect for a quick dinner or snack.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the infused oil, soy sauce, and gochujang.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the sliced chorizo, cooking until browned.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet, tossing to combine with the chorizo and garlic.
Stir in the soy sauce mixture and cook for 1 minute, until the noodles are well coated.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a hot stone plate and top with chopped green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
